title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be working with world class expert drug development consultants in client engagements and be supported during the Business Development process by required expert teams. As a precursor to consultant engagement with the client, our candidates will be responsible for identifying and pursuing strategic business with clients after qualifying them with a needs assessment including, understanding their business model and corporate objectives, understanding their development program focus, objectives and priorities, understanding their critical decisions and challenges and financial position. It is after this qualification process that the appropriate Certara consulting resources are identified for engagement and are introduced to the client as the Certara resource team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pursue strategic business with new clients
* Identify and pursue business growth opportunities within assigned clients
* Conduct proper discovery to understand and qualify client needs, including understanding of business model and corporate objectives, development program focus, and priorities
* Negotiate contract terms by understanding critical decision timelines, challenges, and financial position
* Lead and facilitate client meetings with consulting resources, ensure internal stakeholders are properly briefed on client meeting plan and management
* Act as main liaison for client and Certara
* Facilitate execution of CDA/ MSA
* Collaborate with project team to ensure timely delivery and quality of all project deliverables
* Communicate issues, issue status, and issue resolution on a regular basis
* Provide leadership and timely feedback to keep all stakeholders, including senior management, informed of project progress
* Ensure Salesforce is properly updated

**Qualifications**

* Minimum a Bachelor’s Degree (science related curriculum a plus) with a demonstrated career path in Business Development to support the sought drug development experience and understanding required for this position.
* A seasoned and well-rounded biopharmaceutical executive is required with minimum combined business development experience of 3+ years
* Thorough understanding of the drug development processes, with the ability to converse with C-suite leadership in Biopharma companies, is essential. Thorough understanding of Clinical Pharmacology and Model Informed Drug Development (PK/PD, QSP, PBPK and MBMA) is a plus.
* Possesses broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical space and current macro trends within the industry. Able to lead strategic business planning process based on a thorough understanding of industry trends and opportunities and effectively solve strategic challenges.
* Proven ability to lead initiatives: work collaboratively with teams to achieve objectives. Achieves organizational focus on key priorities. Provides clear direction, delegates, actively communicates. Superior project management skills.
* Proven success in working collaboratively with cross functional commercialization teams with a strong business orientation and ability to view issues from multiple functional perspectives.
* Experienced and adept in a variety of negotiating settings. Able to engage effectively; establishes a clear negotiation strategy and manages a tight process.
* Proven experience in identifying, evaluating and pursuing business development opportunities within new and existing key markets.
* Demonstrated ability to gain credibility through successful leadership in a matrix environment, across a range of functions, position levels and geography
* Strong communication and influencing skills

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Proposals and Contracts Specialist
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovations. With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Proposals and Contracts Specialist, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in shaping the proposals and contracts that bring new clinical studies to life, from receipt of the Request for Proposal (RFP) through to client signature. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow established SOPs and departmental guidance, and contribute to study operations from proposal preparation through contract finalization.
  
  
Responsibilities include managing the full RFP process, developing strategic proposals and budgets, and creating, negotiating, and finalizing contracts, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and grow your influence in proposal and contract strategy.
  
  
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through accurate budgets, sound contract strategy, and high-quality client deliverables. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Proposals and Contracts Specialist can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, negotiate, and finalize contracts in accordance with departmental SOPs, guidance, and work instructions, drafting Parexel templates in conjunction with relevant departments.
* Manage the RFP process from receipt to delivery, including reviewing RFP documentation and study protocols or synopses, assigning and notifying Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and identifying and mitigating barriers and risks to completion.
* Prepare and modify strategic proposals and budgets in response to RFPs and revisions, using SME feedback and proposal management support, in line with the Decision Rights policy.
* Lead and facilitate client meetings to negotiate costs and terms by the targeted client signature date, negotiating independently or with support depending on contract complexity.
* Develop contract strategies and contract plans for delivery and client signature, with accountable team members.
* Amend project and client budgets in partnership with project and functional teams, using internal tools and reports to ensure all information is included from all groups.
* Ensure proposals, budgets, and contract documents align with the RFP, client specifications and communications, and internal assumptions.
* Obtain third-party quotes as needed and map client bid-grids, with support as needed.
* Deliver quality client deliverables to strict deadlines, including formatted client grids that clearly present the rationale for cost changes.
* Identify contractual issues that require finance, tax, or other internal stakeholder input, and apply lessons learned to similar scenarios in new contracts.
* Keep all documents and files saved in the appropriate locations and data current in the systems used for metrics and KPI purposes, such as Salesforce.
* Attend relevant meetings, build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and manage time and workload to meet internal and external deadlines, including preparing detailed handoffs before time off.

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong understanding of the operational aspects of clinical study conduct in different regions of the world, which may be demonstrated through previous work experience in the industry
* Excellent analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to perform several tasks simultaneously
* A consistent commitment to high-quality work and outstanding attention to detail
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make effective, appropriate decisions when necessary
* Sound judgment about when to bring in support or escalate difficult situations and interactions
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, highly developed interpersonal skills, and a strong team orientation
* Confidence interacting with all levels of staff and the ability to lead internal and client meetings
* The ability to meet deadlines independently while managing multiple, varied tasks with enthusiasm and prioritizing workload
* Willingness to work in a matrix environment and to value the importance of teamwork
* A sense of urgency and a positive attitude in everything you do

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Life Science, Business, Languages, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* At least three years of previous experience in project support, finance, contracting, or proposals in a CRO or similar environment
* Standard knowledge of proposal and contract management principles, contractual terms, pricing structures, and pricing tools and data systems (e.g., Salesforce)
* Higher-level knowledge of relevant software, including Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and databases
* Fluent in written and oral English
* Ability to work from home
* Ability to work irregular and/or extended hours as needed to meet the client's proposal deadline

title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Solution Consultant (Pharmacovigilance Consultant, Drug Safety Solutions Specialist) to join our team. As a Senior Solution Consultant, you will drive the design and delivery of innovative pharmacovigilance and drug safety solutions that advance patient safety and regulatory compliance.
  
  
This position plays a key role in solution development, client engagement, pre-award support, and post-award delivery oversight. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across sales, delivery, and therapeutic areas, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to solution development from initial client discovery through successful implementation and account management.
  
  
Responsibilities include developing bespoke safety solutions, supporting strategic sales initiatives, and ensuring seamless handovers to delivery teams, with opportunities to deepen your expertise in pharmacovigilance and influence the strategic direction of Parexel's drug safety business.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through innovative solution design, client-centric consulting, and operational excellence. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Solution Consultant can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and commercial operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead solution development and design of bespoke pharmacovigilance and drug safety solutions that maximize value for clients and differentiate Parexel in the market
* Support sales initiatives through strategic guidance, opportunity identification, and participation in client discovery sessions to understand business objectives and system need
* Develop efficient, competitive, and profitable solutions, including scope definition, budget preparation, and commercial proposals for pre-award and post-award engagement
* Manage client relationships and provide account oversight to ensure solutions meet expectations for time, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction
* Maintain extensive knowledge of pharmacovigilance products, pipelines, competitors, and industry trends to position Parexel for competitive advantage and business growth
* Ensure effective handover of solutions to delivery teams and drive lessons learned feedback loops to achieve continuous improvement
* Partner with cross-functional teams across enterprise accounts, growth accounts, delivery, and marketing to support SBU-specific sales targets and strategic objectives
* Develop and present customer-focused, well-articulated proposal content and budgets that clearly communicate Parexel's value proposition and differentiation

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in strategic thinking, client relationship management, and solution design
* Experience working in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, clinical research, or a regulated healthcare environment
* The ability to collaborate across matrix teams, communicate complex ideas clearly, and build strong cross-functional relationships
* A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and a pragmatic approach to solving business challenges
* Comfort working with commercial systems, proposal management tools, and industry-standard processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, health sciences, or related field
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety Services, or clinical research
* At least 2 years of experience in developing and designing client-specific safety solutions or consulting services
* Proven client-facing experience with strong stakeholder management and consulting skills
* Knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations, ICH-GCP, and clinical trial processes
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in life sciences, business, or related field
* Experience with process improvement methodologies and automation technologies in drug safety or clinical research
* Active participation in industry forums and professional organizations related to pharmacovigilance
* Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed for client engagement and business development

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Customer Trust Lead
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Commvault is seeking a Customer Trust Lead to support customer and prospect security and compliance inquiries and help build confidence in Commvault’s security, privacy, and resilience posture. As a member of the Trust organization, this role serves as a key external-facing representative, engaging with customers to explain security and compliance concepts and guide discussions toward meaningful, business-aligned outcomes across security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer-facing security and compliance inquiries, including questionnaires, due diligence requests, and customer calls.
* Clearly explain Commvault’s security, privacy, data governance, AI, and resilience posture to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Assess and communicate security and compliance risk at the appropriate level, helping customers move beyond unnecessary detail to focus on true business impact and effective mitigation strategies.
* Review security- and compliance-related contract language and customer requirements in partnership with Legal and other internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to provide accurate, consistent, and timely responses.
* Represent the Commvault brand externally with exceptional professionalism, polish, and sound judgment.

**Who you are?**

* 5+ years of experience
* Thorough knowledge of broad security, trust, risk, or compliance topics
* Experience in customer-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of information security, privacy, and risk management principles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and credibly.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Expertise with common security and compliance frameworks and standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, privacy regulations).
* Customer-focused, calm, and confident in high-stakes or ambiguous situations.
* Able to balance attention to detail with big-picture judgment.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and trusted by both customers and internal teams.

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
  
  
Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

**Company: Sid’s Farm**
**About Sid’s Farm**
 Sid’s Farm is a premium dairy brand committed to delivering pure, high\-quality milk and dairy products directly to consumers. With a strong focus on freshness, ethical sourcing, and customer trust, Sid’s Farm continues to expand its footprint across modern trade, key accounts, and alternate sales channels.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Sid’s Farm is looking for a dynamic and result\-driven to acquire and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade chains as alternate revenue sources. The role is responsible for driving revenue growth, managing daily sales performance, monitoring offers, ensuring timely receivables, and building strong strategic partnerships.
   

  

**🔍 What You’ll Do**
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts to drive sales and revenue growth for Sid’s Farm products.
* Identify, acquire, and manage key accounts, aggregators, and modern trade partners.
* Collaborate with Merchandisers to build a strong pipeline of high\-quality prospects and generate sustained demand.
* Maintain strong working relationships with key partner personnel at head offices.
* Coordinate agent support, including training, merchandising, and below\-the\-line (BTL) marketing execution.
* Develop and deploy effective business propositions to accelerate revenue growth.
* Provide back\-office support including preparing quotations, negotiating pricing, and managing customer onboarding and deployment activities.
* Play a key role in new business pitches and ensure seamless onboarding of new clients.
* Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure smooth coordination.
* Monitor daily sales, promotional offers, and performance metrics across accounts.
* Ensure timely collections and effectively manage accounts receivable.
* Perform account reconciliations to maintain accurate statements and invoices.
* Propose innovative promotions and in\-store activities to improve shelf off\-take and visibility.
* Present periodic reports on account performance, goals, and quarterly initiatives to stakeholders.
* Analyse client data and sales trends to enhance customer relationship management and business outcomes.


**✅ What We’re Looking For**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Proven experience in sales, business development, and new account acquisition.
* Strong account management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities.
* Ability to design and improve distribution processes and revenue channels.
* Experience managing inventory and stock across multiple regions.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and result orientation.


 Why Join Sid’s Farm?
   

  

 At Sid’s Farm, we believe operational excellence is key to delivering freshness and quality to our customers. Join us and be part of a fast\-growing brand that values precision, ownership, and teamwork.
